_comment: NYXUS HACKER-MODE Station Matrix — security layout for `nyxus-hacker-mode on`. Wallpapers are ALIEN DARK only (no hacker-mode / kageryu / demon art). NEVER auto-activated at boot.

half_marks._comment: ★ ALIEN GLYPH TABLE — MUST STAY BYTE-IDENTICAL to the `marks` array in stations.json. Hacker mode themes wallpaper and launch commands, never station identity, and the rail must not re-letter itself on a mode flip. Edit stations.json's table and copy it here. Script: Tifinagh (U+2D30), font DejaVu Sans (ships via ttf-dejavu).

_half_comment: Companion ('half') station identities — names identical to stations.json so a mode flip cannot rename them. Their Hyprland workspace rules + launches live in conf.d/nyxus-stations-named.conf, which no generator ever rewrites.

stations.name: OPS
stations.launch: sh -c 'command -v arsenal >/dev/null && kitty --title Arsenal -e arsenal || alacritty'

stations.name: GHOST
stations.launch: sh -c 'command -v bifrost >/dev/null && (bifrost >/dev/null 2>&1 &); alacritty -e sh -c "journalctl -f -u jett-daemon 2>/dev/null || journalctl -xef"'

stations.name: PULSE
stations.launch: sh -c 'command -v meli >/dev/null && (meli >/dev/null 2>&1 &); command -v firefox >/dev/null && firefox --new-window http://localhost:3000 || alacritty'

stations.name: WAVE
stations.launch: sh -c 'alacritty -e sh -c "command -v bandwhich >/dev/null && sudo bandwhich || btop"'

stations.name: CORE
stations.launch: sh -c '[ -d /opt/arsenal/tools/CIPHER ] && (command -v firefox >/dev/null && firefox --new-window http://localhost:8080 || alacritty) || alacritty -e sh -c "cd /opt/arsenal/tools 2>/dev/null; bash"'

stations.name: MESH
stations.launch: sh -c 'alacritty -e sh -c "echo NYXUS GHOST STATUS:; nyxus-ghost status 2>/dev/null; echo; command -v nmap >/dev/null && echo \"nmap ready\"; exec bash"'

stations.name: ARSENAL
stations.launch: sh -c 'alacritty -e sh -c "command -v r2 >/dev/null && echo radare2 ready; exec bash"'
